'''What Makes a Girl?''' (Japanese: '''"女のコ"って？''' ''Like a "Girl"?'') is the fifty-seventh chapter of the [[Magical Pokémon Journey]] manga.

==Plot==
{{incomplete plot}}
[[Apricot]] decides she should be more girly if she wants [[Walnut]] to fall in love with her. However, she doesn't know how. She enlists [[Hazel]] and [[Coconut]] to teach her the ways of femininity.
